subjects.name: Dragons, Monsters and Men (Jordan Peterson Daily Wire series)

summary: A watch-through of the second episode of Jordan Peterson's 2022 Daily Wire series, fact-checking his claims about declining men, women's mate choice, mass shooters and schooling, and recounting how he abandoned his therapy patients as he became famous.

evidence.note: Episode two of season one of the Peterson Daily Wire series introduced as the text being watched
Peterson's claims that men are becoming passive and failing in school, checked against degree data
Peterson's friend Marian Tupy and his abundance claims get a long segment
Tupy's June 2015 National Review piece against the Pope's climate encyclical examined
Host rebuts climate optimism with crop failures and record heat
Media coverage of shootings inflating public fear of crime discussed
Peterson's hypergamy argument about women choosing men by resources
Fatherless mass shooter claim traced to right-wing media and debunked
Canadaland report on Peterson cancelling patients and sharing their information
Patient abandonment dated to the 2016 University of Toronto pronoun fight
Prussian schooling claim checked against Japan's 1870s-1890s education reforms
Peterson's framing of MeToo and tamable-beast fantasies critiqued

notes: Series title ambiguous in transcript: Dragons, Monsters and Men may be the episode or series name. Tupy's birth year not given; floruit 2015 from his article. Covered span starts at Tupy's 2015 article; Japan's Meiji school reforms are a fact-check, not story time. medical-malpractice used for Peterson's patient abandonment as a licensed psychologist; no closer theme. Nine-minute Bosstones digression ignored.
